preEngineeredClimb.description: A module bought already engineered can be taken further at an engineer, and `applyBlueprint` accepts its `recipe_*` id on the module that is sold carrying it even though no engineering menu lists one. The Mercenary Module Reinforcement Package is the case that proves the route: it has no menu at all. It arrives at grade 1, so its recipe defines grades 2-5 only — asking for grade 1 is asking to recreate the purchase, which no recipe can do.
